content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Bhilai Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Manager (Post Doctoral Researcher): PhD in Mechanical Engineering with a minimum of 1 year of postdoctoral experience and at least 3 months of research experience at a reputed national-level research institute/laboratory, such as IIT, IISc, CSIR, or equivalent. Project Engineer: MTech/ME/MS in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology or equivalent with a minimum of 2 years of research experience at a reputed national-level research institute/laboratory, such as IIT, IISc, CSIR, or an equivalent institution.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Project Manager (Post Doctoral Researcher): Maximum 50 years. Project Engineer: Minimum 45 years and Maximum 50 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Bhilai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application by email to [email protected] . Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Bhilai recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Bhilai project-based positions is 12 October 2026. Candidates are encouraged to submit their documents well before this deadline to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available under this recruitment drive. This includes 1 position for Project Manager (Post Doctoral Researcher) and 1 position for Project Engineer, both operating under a research-based project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of selection for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised positions at IIT Bhilai will be conducted through an offline interview. Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend the interview in person at the designated venue on 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the IIT Bhilai recruitment. Candidates can apply for the positions without any financial obligation regarding application processing charges.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Manager (Post Doctoral Researcher) position will receive a monthly salary ranging from 80,000 to 1,00,000, depending on their qualifications and experience as per the project guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: For the Project Engineer position, the candidate must be between 45 and 50 years of age. Please ensure you meet this age criteria before submitting your application to the institute.

faq.question: Q7. Where should I send my application?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must send their completed application form and supporting documents to the official email address: [email protected]. It is also required to keep the Principal Investigator (PI) at [email protected] in the CC field.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must submit a filled application form, copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, and a detailed list of research publications. Ensure all documents are self-attested and attached clearly in your email submission.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any TA/DA provided for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the Indian Institute of Technology, Bhilai will not provide any TA/DA (Traveling Allowance/Dearness Allowance) to candidates attending the interview. Candidates must make their own travel arrangements to reach the venue.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of these project-based jobs?
faq.answer: The tenure for both the Project Manager and Project Engineer positions is for a duration of 1 year. These roles are specifically created for a research project funded by TIH-IITB.
